ageGate.headline: Know who’s ready.
ageGate.intro: πroka is an adults-only community for queer adults. Confirm your date of birth to enter.
ageGate.underage: You must be 18 or older to use πroka.
ageGate.agree: By entering you agree to our <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

safety.detailPlaceholder: Add anything that helps a moderator (optional)
safety.encrypted: Messages stay encrypted; only what you write here is shared with moderators.
safety.criticalNote: Reports about minors or violence are reviewed first.
safety.thankYouBody: A moderator will review your report. We don’t share the outcome, but we act on every report. You can block {name} so they can’t reach you.
safety.blockConfirm: Block {name}? They won’t be able to message you and this chat will disappear from your inbox.
safety.shareForbidden: Verify your health card in Me before sharing it.
safety.shareFail: Could not share your health card.
safety.shareOk: Your health card is now visible to {name}.

reasons.stalking: Stalking, doxxing, or sharing my location
